visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a black jacket and pants stands next to a dark grey and white Volkswagen van on a grey pebble beach. He looks out at the overcast sky and the waves of the ocean. (2) Close-up of the man's face from the side as he gazes at the horizon with a calm expression. (3) Wide shot of dark, thick storm clouds moving across the sky above the sea. (4) A small lantern illuminates a dark interior space, presumably the van or a tent, at night. (5) Steam rises from a metal kettle on a stove. (6) The man inside the van rearranges items and spreads out a green sleeping bag on the folded-down rear seats. (7) A full moon is visible through passing dark clouds in the night sky. (8) The man wakes up in the sleeping bag, sitting up and looking around the van interior in the morning light. (9) Close-up of raindrops on the van's glass window with a blurred view of the sea behind it. (10) A blue flame ignites on a portable gas stove under a pot. (11) Rice boils vigorously in a pot of water. (12) A bowl of hot, steaming white rice is shown in a close-up shot. (13) The man, now wearing a hooded brown jacket, walks along the sandy shoreline towards the water. (14) The man crouches on a rocky part of the beach, looking at the ground; a wind turbine is visible in the distant background under a grey sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Continuous sounds of crashing ocean waves and a constant low-frequency wind roar dominate the opening. Acoustic guitar strumming fades in slowly. (2) A male singer's smooth, melodic tenor voice enters, singing emotional lyrics over the acoustic guitar and a light percussion beat. (3) A sharp hiss of steam escaping a kettle cuts through the music momentarily. (4) Loud rustling of nylon fabric accompanies the movement of a sleeping bag being spread out. (5) A distinct mechanical double-click sound marks the ignition of a gas burner, followed by the faint roar of a flame. (6) The sound of water bubbling and roiling in a pot becomes prominent, overlapping with the persistent BGM. (7) Music continues with the singer reaching a higher register as the ambient beach sounds fade back in at the end.
